videos.title: What i eat in a day 👩🏻‍🍳 (vegan + easy)
videos.description:
My first “what i eat in a day” here on shorts! Should I do more?? 👀

All the recipes are all from my new cookbook, Simply Plants! I made gluten-free buckwheat crêpes for breakfast, spicy pulled mushroom tacos with jalapeño lime aioli for lunch, and shahi tofu curry for dinner. Yum, yum, yum!
